description: Header file defining the 'nrppa_impl' class, which implements interfaces for handling NRPPa messages, UE context removal, and related functionalities within the ocudu::ocucp namespace. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and private member variables related to NRPPa processing in a 5G/telecom context.

classes.name: nrppa_impl
classes.description: Implementation class for NRPPa message handling, UE context management, and related functionalities within the ocudu::ocucp namespace.

methods.name: nrppa_impl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the NRPPa implementation with configuration, notifier, and scheduler.

methods.name: ~nrppa_impl
methods.description: Destructor for the NRPPa implementation class.

methods.description: Handles incoming NRPPa Protocol Data Units (PDUs) with associated UE or AMF index.

methods.name: remove_ue_context
methods.description: Removes the UE context identified by ue_index.

methods.name: initialize_meas_report_timer
methods.description: Initializes measurement report timer for a specific UE.
